run_evaluate_pretrained_model: run the evaluate script to fine-tune a pretrained resnet50 model on ImageNet with distributed training
run_linear_probe_freeze: run linear probing evaluation by freezing backbone weights and training only the classifier head on ImageNet
run_partial_dataset_eval: run evaluation on a 10 percent subset of ImageNet training data for faster linear classification benchmarking
test_accuracy_topk: test the accuracy function that computes top-k classification accuracy over model predictions and targets
review_average_meter: review the AverageMeter class that tracks and computes running averages for metrics like accuracy during training
